Mac 'n' Cheese
 
Save Print
Author: Tilamook
Recipe type: Appetizer
Cuisine: American
Ingredients
  • 1 Pound(s) Elbow Macaroni
  • 2 heavy cream
  • 1 Cup(s) grated cheddar cheese
  • 1 Cup(s) Tillamook Triple Cheddar Shredded Cheese
  • 1 Cup(s) mozzarella grated cheese
  • ½ Cup(s) Fontina Cheese-cubed
  • ¼ Teaspoon(s) salt
  • ⅛ Teaspoon(s) cayenne pepper
  • ½ Teaspoon(s) garlic powder
  • ⅛ Teaspoon(s) ground white pepper
Instructions
  1. Start by bringing 2 qts of water and 1 tbsp of salt to a boil. Add 1 pound of elbow macaroni and cook to “al dente”.
  2. Rinse briefly with cold water to stop the cooking process. Toss with 2 tablespoons of oil to prevent sticking.
  3. Heat cream to just below a boil and add Medium Cheddar Cheese, 3 Year Vintage White Extra Sharp Cheddar Cheese, and fontina cheese. Add triple shredded cheese blend to the cream and stir to melt.
  4. Add Mozzarella and allow to melt, then add all seasonings, stirring all the while. When all cheeses are melted sauce is ready.
  5. At this point, pour some mac sauce onto cooked noodles and toss, coating generously. Note: it will not require all the sauce.
  6. Fill, desired baking dish (spray with cooking spray first) with tossed noodles, leaving a little room at the top. Top with more Mac sauce (spreading on cold sauce is best).
  7. To serve: Bake in a 450°F oven until warm and bubbly (an 8 oz crock takes about 10 minutes).
